name: Northline Offices
blurb: A daylight-first workplace wrapped in a self-shading facade.
body:
A daylight-first workplace wrapped in a self-shading facade.

The brief for Northline Offices asked for a commercial project that responds to its setting in Berlin, Germany. We planned it around light, views and everyday movement, then built it with our own crews.

Materials were chosen to age well on site, and the same team stayed with the project from first sketch to handover in 2024.
